note: Multiple cohorts report seizures occurring in 25% to 43% of affected individuals with FBXO11 pathogenic variants.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 21 previously unreported individuals with heterozygous pathogenic FBXO11 variants, seizures were observed in 43% of cases.

source.title: Defining FBXO11-Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder: Clinical, Molecular and Facial Assessment of 21 Patients
source.quote: Microcephaly occurred in 24%, while seizures were present in 43%.

evidence.text: Among 20 individuals identified with de novo variants in FBXO11, seizures were documented in 5 individuals (25%).

source.title: De novo variants in the F-box protein FBXO11 in 20 individuals with a variable neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: behavioral problems (17/20), seizures (5/20), cleft lip or palate or bifid uvula (3/20), and minor skeletal anomalies.
